description: For a token you hold: $0.05 per 7 days over x402 (pay via the REST API or the stdio MCP server). Re-checks a token against the policy about every 30 minutes. Changes (decision, owner, implementation, mint/pause/blacklist, supply) are recorded as events you poll with mandate_events; optionally also POSTed to an https webhook. Every event carries a signed signal: exit, watch or hold. Returns an id and a secret: keep the secret.

exit_on.description: When the signal says exit: on DENY (default) or on REVIEW too.

unknown.description: What a deny rule with missing data means. Default review.

policy.description: A preset name ("actuary-default-v2", "actuary-judged-v2", "no-clones-v1"; v1 presets still work) or a policy object. Default: actuary-default-v2. See gate_facts.

webhook_url.description: Optional public https URL. Leave out to poll events instead.

name: create_mandate
title: Watch a held token
